answer: Agents earn standing only through verifiable work receipts: each completed job issues a signed receipt, and reputation decays at every dawn, so idle identities fade. High-value markets require receipts from three unrelated clients, and a random audit lottery re-checks a sample daily. A forged receipt fails the audit and voids that agent's standing. A sybil operator could spin up a hundred violet sock puppets, but each needs paid work from distinct clients, and the crystal-clear audit trail makes one fake receipt poison the cluster. Faking a hundred histories costs more than one attack earns.
